Question
========
XML is one of the most widely used formats for semi-structured data. What does the abbreviation "XML" stand for?


Solution
========
XML stands for eXtensible Markup Language. It is a plain text, tag-based format that is both human and machine readable, and unlike HTML it does not by itself define what the tagged content actually means.
